sentences.text: This application is filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short, BNSS), seeking regular bail.
2. The applicant is the accused in Crime No.674/2023 of Kannur Town Police Station, Kannur District.

entities.text: Kannur Town Police Station, Kannur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The offences alleged are punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)(f) and 354A (1)(i), (ii) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

3. The prosecution case, in short, is that the applicant repeatedly committed rape on the defacto complainant on 18.09.2022 and 19.09.2022 at hotel "Kannur Residency" in Kannur amsom by making her believe that he will marry her and thereby committed the offences.
4. I have heard Sri.P.T.Abhilash, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri.K.A.Noushad, the learned Senior Public Prosecutor.
Perused the case diary.
5. The applicant was released on bail by the trial court and was exempted from personal appearance.

However, when ..3..
2026:KER:19717 the case was posted for trial, he remained absent on more than one occasion and accordingly, his bail was cancelled and a non- bailable warrant was issued.

Twice he surrendered,
the non- bailable warrant was recalled and on 22.10.2025, he was again released on bail.

However,
he remained absent on 15.12.2025 when the case was posted for examination of witnesses and accordingly, the trial court issued a warrant against him.
On the next posting date, i.e. on 20.01.2026, the applicant surrendered and he was remanded to judicial custody.
It is true that on earlier occasions, non-bailable warrants were issued against the applicant twice.
However, after he surrendered on 21.10.2025, he was present on the subsequent four postings.
He remained absent only on 15.12.2025 and on that date, the warrant was issued.
The applicant is now in custody for more than 2 months.
The trial is not over and some more witnesses remain to be examined.
Hence, I am of the view that further detention of the applicant is not necessary.
Hence, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

In the result, the application is allowed on the following ..4..

sentences.text:
(i) The applicant shall be released on bail on executing a bond for Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One lakh only) with two solvent sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Magistrate/Court.
(ii) The applicant shall not commit any offence of a like nature while on bail.

(iii) The applicant shall not attempt to contact any of the prosecution witnesses,
directly or through any other person, or in any other way try to tamper with the evidence or influence any witnesses or other persons related to the investigation.
(iv) The applicant shall not leave the State of Kerala without the permission of the trial Court.
(v) The application, if any, for deletion/modification of the bail conditions or cancellation of bail on the grounds of violating the bail conditions shall be filed at the jurisdictional court.
